questions.description: Specific questions for the human, one sentence each plus short options. Shown as a numbered list after `reply`. Empty unless status is needs_clarification.

title.description: Short PR title for the change (no issue number).

summary.description: The design proposal in Markdown with sections Request, Acceptance criteria, Design, Test plan, Out of scope, Assumptions. Becomes the PR description and, on approval, the frozen contract on the issue.

reply.description: Short Markdown message to the humans (at most ~6 lines): what changed and, for feedback not answered in a thread, how you handled it. Do not repeat the design or the thread replies.

comment_id.description: comment_id of an inline comment shown in the conversation.

body.description: One or two sentences: what you did about this comment, or why you made no change.

thread_replies.description: One in-thread reply per NEW inline review comment you were given. Empty if there are none.
